claims.assertion: Yazhi says an Orion Council alliance led by Alpha Draconis invaded Vega, Avalon, and Lyra about one million years ago, scattering peaceful Lyrians in the Great Expansion.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the United Federation of Planets formed about 900,000 years ago as species allied for mutual protection against the Reptilian invasion.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Lyrians settled Earth around 40,000 years ago; humans and Taygetans are humanlike Lyrian-base species, unlike insectoid, saurian, feline, or amphibian groups.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
